verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is a platform that runs servers, publishing and analytics, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. The probe found no OpenAPI document: every candidate path, including openapi.json, swagger.json and .well-known/openapi.json, returned 404. The llms.txt file and markdown docs that do exist are documentation indexes, not machine-readable API specs, and the MCP tooling is a different capability (adjacent at best).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
